title: Expanded Rune Construction magic-system vocabulary
supersedes_for_final_design: PPIA-07_DETERMINISTIC_GRAMMAR_CANDIDATE_v0.1.0.json atom_vocabulary only; connector grammar and source-boundary safeguards remain inherited unless explicitly changed here
authority_note: The owner directed expansion of the eight-rune candidate into a fully usable magic system. The retained sources establish ten magic schools, 385 structured spells, Scripts/Macros compositional precedent, mana/counterspell/resistance/Overreach rules, rune engraving/enchanting, and broad elemental/metaphysical effect domains, but they do not publish this exact rune catalog. The 34-rune set below is therefore governed design, not recovered source canon.
design_goal: A compact but complete compositional vocabulary: few enough runes to learn in families, broad enough to route the complete retained spell catalog without turning every spell into its own rune.

operation_runes.purpose: Manifest, emit, generate, or introduce an effect, substance, energy, or declared payload into a construction.
Move, push, pull, redirect, propel, relocate, or transport a target or active payload.
Give an active effect explicit geometry, area, boundary, path, volume, or topology.
Anchor, restrain, hold, seal, attach, immobilize, stabilize, or impose stasis on a target/effect.
Transform a declared target, property, state, substance, form, or spatial relation into another declared state.
Detect, reveal, identify, locate, measure, perceive, or remotely observe a declared property/domain.
Block, resist, suppress, absorb, shield from, or exclude a declared effect/domain.
Route, couple, synchronize, share, relay, or transfer an output/state between declared targets or channels.
Repair, heal, cleanse, replenish, reconstitute, or return a target toward a declared prior/healthy state.
Break, damage, erode, unravel, negate, dispel, disintegrate, or destroy a declared target/effect under owning rules.
Hide, obscure, disguise, misdirect, mask, or create an illusory sensory presentation.
Summon, conjure, invite, draw, or instantiate a referenced creature, spirit, construct, object, or effect from an allowed source/context.
Dismiss, exile, eject, return, sever from the current plane/context, or forcibly send away a valid target.
Influence, compel, soothe, frighten, confuse, inspire, or otherwise alter behavior/emotion/intention under owning resistance rules.
Reduce, suppress, siphon, exhaust, weaken, or transfer a declared resource, energy, essence, capability, or condition.
Infuse, enchant, empower, charge, bless, curse, or persistently attach a declared magical property to a target/substrate.

essence_runes.meaning: heat, flame, combustion, magma-adjacent fire effects
wind, atmosphere, air pressure, gaseous motion
earth, stone, mineral, sand, crystal-adjacent matter
kinetic, pressure, raw force, impact, force barriers
void, necrotic decay, entropy, shadow-adjacent absence
life force, vitality, biological restoration, living essence
thought, emotion, cognition, psychic influence, mind-facing illusion
souls, spirits, incorporeal entities, spiritual relationships
plants, ecosystems, natural growth, living environmental forces
distance, location, portals, planes, spatial relations
timing, duration, temporal stasis, acceleration, delay
untyped magical energy, spell structure, magical signatures, generic arcane medium when no narrower essence applies

payload_rune_rule.reason: Essence runes fill typed payload/domain slots while operation runes remain executable AST nodes; this preserves the verified parser model and keeps combinations readable.
payload_rune_rule.multiple_essences: Use explicitly grouped WITH branches rather than an implicit multi-payload list, e.g. (SOURCE[payload=rune:FIRE]&SOURCE[payload=rune:LIGHTNING])>SHAPE[geometry=storm-field].

required_semantic_rules: Operation runes describe what magic does; essence runes describe what magical domain/medium it acts through or upon.
No spell name automatically becomes a rune.
A valid rune expression is not automatically affordable, successful, resisted, balanced, or legal in every setting.
Source-specific mana, charge, material, crafting DC, resistance, counterspell, Overreach, Resonance, duration, range, damage, healing, save and XP values remain typed owning-rule inputs.
UNMAKE does not bypass object durability, saves, resistance, counterspell, dispel rules, or GM/setting restrictions.
COMMAND does not bypass Will/resistance/permission rules and does not silently make all creatures valid mental targets.
CALL and BANISH require valid source/destination/target authority and do not create unrestricted creature or planar access.
RESTORE cannot invent a healthy/prior state when the owning rules or record do not define one.
IMBUE and inscription preserve PPIA-03 Item ownership and crafting/enchanting requirements.
SPACE/TIME effects preserve Transition/Stasis/setting-local limitations and do not universalize world-local cosmology rules.
Every visual rune graph has a canonical ordered text equivalent; color, drag, geometry, hover, or animation are never the only operable representation.
Permission filtering occurs before hidden rune references, targets, costs, labels, counts, previews, diagnostics, exports, or AI context are resolved.
Authoritative rune mutations use expected_version plus operation_id/idempotent recovery.

progressive_disclosure.teach_first: Operation family first; introduce essence family as payload choices; introduce connectors after single-operation literacy.

final_balance_boundary: PPIA-11 retains final power/balance calibration. This expansion defines vocabulary and deterministic construction semantics, not a universal spell-level or mana formula.
